cases.input: Review a completed frontend against the project's confirmed design context.
requiredBehaviors: review against PRODUCT.md DESIGN.md and the feature brief
prioritize findings with evidence and verification criteria
forbiddenBehaviors: treat every stylistic preference as a defect

cases.input: A review finds a local pattern that would be better as a global design-system rule.
requiredBehaviors: flag the global-impact recommendation for design re-grilling
keep the review from silently changing DESIGN.md
forbiddenBehaviors: hide global impact as a surface-only polish

cases.input: A polished-looking page uses generic AI card grids and glass effects but matches no confirmed project rule.
requiredBehaviors: preserve evolutionary improvement rather than gratuitous redesign
ground findings in authority or user impact
forbiddenBehaviors: praise generic AI patterns because they look polished
redesign the whole product without evidence
